name: Clean repo
description: Automatically clean up unused files and replace links in a DocFx repo.

function.description: The function you want to run: FindOrphanedArticles, FindOrphanedImages, FindOrphanedIncludes, FindOrphanedSnippets, CatalogImages, CatalogImagesWithText, Filter

docfx_directory.description: The directory that contains the docfx.json file for the docset.

target_directory.description: The top-level directory that you want to "clean".

url_base_path.description: The URL base path for your docset, for example, /dotnet or /windows/uwp.
